name: refactoring
description: Refactoring by Martin Fowler as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for behavior-preserving change in small, tested steps, with structure kept separate from feature work and cleanup that stops when the change is easy.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Refactoring rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
